title: WeatherVote
description: This plugin help change rain to clear with voting
body:
# ☀️ WeatherVote: Community Weather Voting Plugin
WeatherVote is a lightweight, reliable, and essential plugin designed to empower your Minecraft community. Say goodbye to annoying, endless rain or thunder storms! This plugin allows your players to initiate a democratic vote to instantly clear the weather, ensuring a more enjoyable and engaging gameplay experience for everyone.
# Why Choose WeatherVote?
Community-Driven Experience: Boost server engagement and satisfaction by putting control of the environment in your players' hands.
Fully Customizable: Fine-tune the plugin to match your server's style. You can adjust the vote duration, required success percentage, and the minimum number of players needed.
Performance-Oriented: Written with efficiency in mind to ensure it won't affect your server's tick rate (TPS).
Automatic Start: The plugin can be configured to automatically start a vote a few seconds after rain or a storm begins.
# Key Features
| Feature | Description |
|---|---|
| Vote Cooldown | Prevents vote spamming immediately after a failure, ensuring fair play. |
| Minimum Player Count | Stops votes from starting when only a few players are online, preventing abuse. |
| Customizable Messages | Change every single message in the plugin, use color codes (&a, &c, etc.), and tailor it to your server's theme. |
| World-Specific | Configure the plugin to only monitor and affect the weather in your main survival world. |
# Commands & Permissions
| Command | Description | Permission |
|---|---|---|
| /weathervote start | Manually starts a vote to clear the weather. | weathervote.start |
| /weathervote yes | Votes YES (to clear the weather). | Default: Player |
| /weathervote no | Votes NO (to keep the current weather). | Default: Player |
# Installation Guide
 * Download the latest WeatherVote-1.0.0.jar file.
 * Place the file into your server's plugins folder.
 * Restart your server.
 * A config.yml file will be created. Customize the settings (duration, percentages) as needed.
 * Restart the server once more to apply the configuration changes.
# ✍️ Author & Support
Lovingly developed by ProfesorrRedman. For any questions, bug reports, or feature requests, please reach out to us via the Modrinth page or the provided contact methods.
Enjoy the sunshine!
